name: Voxel-based Transfer Function Optimization
definition: A method to optimize a target transfer function $T_o$ by minimizing the color difference between a reference volume (rendered with $T_r$) and an optimization volume (rendered with $T_o$) at the voxel level. It assumes density values are given at vertices of a rectangular grid and uses trilinear interpolation for density, while the transfer function is discretized into $n_T$ bins with linear interpolation.
summary: Voxel-based Transfer Function Optimization automatically computes an optimized transfer function by minimizing color differences at the individual voxel level using a deterministic least-squares solution.
